justifications.structure: Clean Cargo workspace: engine (model/topology/rcm/skyline/analysis/output) has no I/O; cli, server, bridge are thin consumers; Dart splits engine/state/ui with native/web engine impls behind one Engine interface.
justifications.naming: Small focused modules with doc comments (skyline.rs factor explains g_ij/U_ij/d_j; topology.rs documents dof maps); analysis.rs solve_case is a long ~150-line function and the 3*node+comp / pos*6 index arithmetic needs care.
justifications.errors: ModelError{code,detail} flows to CLI exit 2 + JSON (main.rs Failure), HTTP 422 via ApiError::Model (server main.rs), and 'code|detail' strings parsed by EngineError.from into UI banner (app_state.dart); weak spots: CLI treats malformed JSON as exit 1 not a model error, string-prefix parsing is brittle, and engine_move_and_solve leaves the dragged position committed when the solve fails.
justifications.boundary: No hand-written unsafe except the counting GlobalAlloc in cli/alloc.rs; FRB/wasm-bindgen wrap one plain-Rust api.rs with a Mutex<Option<Session>> (poison handled), views are owned flat Vecs copied across, web views free()'d; node ids narrowed i64->i32 and u32 profile casts are unchecked, and the global singleton session is implicit.
justifications.tests: Real unit tests: engine/tests/engine.rs (closed-form cantilever and SS UDL, factor-once, error codes, RCM determinism, skyline vs dense solve, JSON shape), bridge session lifecycle test, sweep tests, Dart tests; but no tests for releases/springs numerics or condense(), and Dart tests are thin (3).
justifications.change_resilience: A new load type touches model, validation, assembly/equilibrium, flat-array view, wasm getters, regenerated FRB, two Dart mappers, ModelData and the scene renderer (about 10 places), with positional flat arrays like udlIx/udlW making each addition ad hoc.

load_type_touch_points: crates/engine/src/analysis.rs:solve_case (end forces, udl storage, equilibrium sums)
crates/server/src/sweep.rs (only if sweep should vary it)
notable: Strength: engine is dependency-light and pure; Topology is separated from coordinates/loads so drag re-solves reuse it and only reassemble/refactor.
Strength: output.rs streams stations from end forces, and CLI/server/bridge share one ModelError type.
Risk: api.rs engine_move_and_solve mutates the session node before solving; a zero_length or unstable result leaves the bad position in the session (no rollback).
Risk: bridge casts node/member ids i64->i32 and profile u64->u32 with no check; session is a process-global Mutex singleton.
Risk: server store.rs uses Mutex::unwrap on SQLite connection (poison panics) and engine tests do not cover releases/springs/condense numerics.
